title: eza webhook
description: A webhook subscription, stored in one user database and exchanged over /api/v1/webhooks. One schema covers both shapes: a create or PATCH payload and the stored/exported object. `name`, `url` and `events` are required; `enabled` is optional because an omitted value means true on create, and the server-assigned fields (`id`, `created_at`, `last_status`, `last_attempt_at`, `last_error`, `fail_streak`) are optional because they only appear on a stored object. Event kinds may repeat in an input document; the server de-duplicates them before storing and keeps them unique, so the array does not use uniqueItems. Delivery is at least once, signed with HMAC, retried, and disabled after a terminal failure. The URL is data; extensions v1 never executes webhook-provided code.

id.description: Server-assigned subscription id. Optional on create; always present on a stored object.

url.description: Absolute http or https delivery URL. The pattern rejects whitespace, credential (user:pass@) URLs, an empty host and an all-dot host; the server additionally applies its stricter runtime policy before storing the subscription.

events.description: Event kinds this webhook subscribes to, one to four. Duplicates are accepted on input and de-duplicated before storage.

enabled.description: Delivery is attempted only while true. Optional on create/PATCH: omitted means true. Always present on a stored object.

created_at.description: POSIX seconds. Server-assigned; always present on a stored object.

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last delivery attempt, or null before the first attempt. Stored object only.

last_attempt_at.description: POSIX seconds of the last delivery attempt, or null before the first attempt. Stored object only.

last_error.description: Last delivery error message, empty when there was none. Stored object only.

fail_streak.description: Consecutive failed delivery attempts. Stored object only.
